top_signal.title: Where does your supplier order info actually live?
top_signal.summary: Curious how other people importing from overseas handle this.   Every order with my supplier ends up spread across a bunch of places. Pricing and quantity get agreed in WeChat, the PI comes by email, spec changes happen in a chat thread, and the deposit terms are in a different email from two weeks ago. If someone on my side asks "what did we land on for the packaging," I'm digging through three apps to answer.   A few questions for people ordering regularly from overseas:   - Where does the back and forth with your supplier actually happen? Email, WeChat, Alibaba messages, all of the above?  - If someone else on your team needs to see the current state of an order, how do they get it?  - How do you know which PI is the current one?  - Have you set up anything that keeps it in one place, or is it spreadsheets and discipline?   Not looking for supplier recommendations, just how you run the process.       submitted by     /u/ProgressDistinct884       [link]       [comments]
